ops.text: (b) Ownership of Content, Customer Data and Deliverables. As between the Parties, Customer owns and retains all right, title and interest, including all intellectual property rights, in and to the Content, the Properties, the Inventory, the Requests, and all data and materials provided or made available by Customer or collected from the Content, the Properties or Customer's users in connection with the Services (collectively, "Customer Data"). Kubient owns and retains all right, title and interest in and to the Auction Platform and its other pre-existing technology, tools and know-how, together with any general improvements thereto. Kubient hereby assigns to Customer all right, title and interest in and to any deliverables, reports, analyses or other work product created for Customer under this Agreement (excluding Kubient's pre-existing technology), and grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense any Kubient intellectual property embedded in such deliverables for Customer's business purposes. Kubient is granted only a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use Customer Data during the Term solely as necessary to provide the Services, and no right, title or interest in Customer Data or Customer's other intellectual property is assigned or transferred to Kubient. Nothing in this Agreement creates joint ownership of any intellectual property.

input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no ownership provision, so we have added one confirming that AP retains all rights in its Content, Properties and Request/user data, that Kubient assigns any deliverables it creates for us (with a licence back to any embedded Kubient IP), and that Kubient receives only a limited service-delivery licence in Customer Data with no joint ownership. Kubient keeps the Auction Platform and its pre-existing tools, so this simply confirms the parties' expected positions; if Kubient prefers, we can accept a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to deliverables instead of assignment.
input.summary: Add IP and Customer Data ownership clause: AP owns Content/Properties/data and deliverables; Kubient keeps platform; limited licence only, no joint ownership.
